# Terra Charge system (charge model)

- **Status:** 🔶 Partial
- **Skills affected:** Frost Terra
- **Mechanic tags:** charge, uptime, damage-pool, more-multiplier, terra
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-10 by Tyra
- **Backlog:** `TERRA-01` (see `docs/INGAME_VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.md`)

## Setup

Owner in-game check (2026-08-10): watched charge pips across the current Terra skill roster.

## Raw data points

CONFIRMED in-game (Tyra, 2026-08-10):

- **Base restoration: 1 stack per 0.5 s for every current Terra skill** (technically skill-specific per the data, but all present skills read 0.5s).
- **Base max stacks: 1, universally.** Ground Divide (+1), grafts/craft affixes, the tower-sequence node, and the Mirrored Shade pact-spirit conditional are the only sources that raise it (SS13).

OWNER-RULED (not a measurement): consumed charges enhance the **entire Terra lifetime** — so a steady-state MORE factor is exact, not an approximation. (Distinct from the Tidewell/Fallen Star magnificent supports' Spell-Burst consume quirks — see SPELLBURST-04.)

## Derived / confirmed formula

Restore duration per stack = 0.5 s / (1 + Σ Terra Charge Recovery/Restoration Speed) — Help DB formula.
Effective max stacks = 1 + Σ Max Terra Charge Stacks.
Damage factor = 1 + per_charge × charges_consumed (Frost Terra per_charge = 0.26), applied as ONE MORE multiplier to the skill's hit AND DoT damage.
Default charges_consumed = effective max (exact at realistic recast cadences given the 0.5s restore); user-overridable via the terra_charges_consumed condition, clamped to [0, max].

## Notes / caveats / open questions

OPEN QUESTIONS (TERRA-01):
1. **Per-charge stacking rule** — community claim that consumed charges compound multiplicatively ((1.26)^N) rather than additively (1 + 0.26N, the modeled read). Discriminating A/B: same build, 1 vs 2 max stacks (Ground Divide) — additive predicts 1.52/1.26 ratio between arms, multiplicative 1.5876/1.26. DO NOT switch the model without this measurement.
2. Fast-cadence auto-cast (Wind Rhythm / Rhythm) can outpace the restore so max is NOT reached — deferred (owner-approved); the condition override covers it manually for now.

KNOWN-UNMAPPED Terra lines (tracked, not silently dropped):
- Legendary gear: "Terra Charge's Restoration Speed is set to (240–300) % of the default value" — a SET-TO override, not a +% bonus; no stat models set-to semantics for this pool yet.
- Grafts: "80/100 % chance to gain 1 charge stacks when using a Terra Skill" — a charge-generation proc; irrelevant under the assume-max default, would matter for the deferred fast-cadence model.
